title: Theta Lift Map on Supercuspidal Data
body_html:
Theta Lift Map on Supercuspidal Data

Fix a Witt tower \(T'\) of target hermitian spaces. For a supercuspidal datum \(\Sigma\) of \(G=U(V)\), write its block decomposition as \[ \Sigma=\bigoplus_{l=0}^{b}\Sigma_l, \] where \(\Sigma_0\) is the zero-depth block and the blocks \(\Sigma_l\) for \(l>0\) have positive depths.

For \(l>0\), define \[ \Sigma_l'=\#^+(\Sigma_l). \] These positive-depth blocks determine target spaces \(V_l'\). The zero-depth block is then lifted in the residual Witt tower obtained by subtracting the Witt classes of the positive-depth target spaces from \(T'\). Finally, take the direct sum of all target blocks: \[ \#_{V,T'}([\Sigma]) = \left[\bigoplus_{l=0}^{b}\Sigma_l'\right]. \]

This map is the data-level correspondence used in the main theorem. It combines moment-map transport for positive-depth blocks with finite-field theta correspondence for the depth-zero residue.
